brief:
Demonstrators including anti-Zionist Orthodox Jews gathered near West 33rd Street and 7th Avenue in New York City to protest the presence of former Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant, Eye on Palestine reported. They called for his immediate arrest under an unspecified legal provision.

The action marked a show of opposition to Israeli military leadership among activist groups in the United States.
